title.zh: 澄江管状触手冠动物样本来源限定证据

description.en: Open the Explorer at Yuganotheca elegans to inspect the linked, locator-bearing source claim together with this package's current occurrence context. This is a reproducible evidence entry point, not a phylogenetic result or a complete history of the group.
description.zh: 在探索器中打开澄江管状触手冠动物样本，结合本包当前的出现记录背景检查带有精确来源定位的关联声明。这是可复现的证据检查入口，不是系统发育结果，也不是该类群的完整历史。

limitations: The linked claim retains its own specimen, stratum, model, confidence and source-locator boundaries. The Explorer route does not establish an exact origin, global first or last appearance, direct ancestry, causal mechanism or package-specific phylogeny.

title.en: Micrina and Yuganotheca elegans occurrence window
title.zh: 小米克里纳虫与澄江管状触手冠动物样本出现窗口

description.en: Open a source-bounded Micrina and Yuganotheca elegans time window in the map to inspect sampled occurrence context linked to this package.
description.zh: 在地图中打开有来源边界的小米克里纳虫与澄江管状触手冠动物样本时间窗口，检查与本包关联的采样出现背景。

limitations: The interval follows the linked package range and claim; map markers are sampled records and do not establish a complete distribution, exact origination or extinction, or direct ancestry.

title.zh: 软体动物与腕足动物证据比较

description.en: Compare Micrina and Yuganotheca elegans through package-linked claims and bounded occurrence context; this side-by-side route is an evidence inspection aid.
description.zh: 通过本包关联的声明与限定出现背景比较小米克里纳虫与澄江管状触手冠动物样本；并列页面仅用于证据检查。

limitations: The two sides retain separate source, sampling, range and uncertainty boundaries; visual differences are not tests of evolutionary causation or a package-specific phylogeny.

description.zh: 在地图中打开有来源边界的波杰塔贝时间窗口，检查与本包关联的采样出现背景。

limitations: The interval follows the linked package range and claim; map markers are sampled records and do not establish a complete distribution, exact origination or extinction, or direct ancestry.

title.zh: 软体动物与腕足动物证据比较

description.en: Compare Pojetaia runnegari and Kutorgina chengjiangensis through package-linked claims and bounded occurrence context; this side-by-side route is an evidence inspection aid.
description.zh: 通过本包关联的声明与限定出现背景比较波杰塔贝与澄江顾脱贝；并列页面仅用于证据检查。

limitations: The two sides retain separate source, sampling, range and uncertainty boundaries; visual differences are not tests of evolutionary causation or a package-specific phylogeny.

description.en: Open the 558–555 Ma White Sea Kimberella sample window in the map to inspect the source-linked body-fossil evidence and its bounded occurrence context.
description.zh: 在地图中打开 558–555 Ma 的金伯虫白海样本窗口，检查带来源关联的身体化石证据及其限定出现背景。

limitations: The 556.5 Ma map age is the rounded midpoint of a 558–555 Ma White Sea assemblage window, not a direct date for any specimen, a global Kimberella duration or a molluscan FAD.

More than 35 named-assemblage body fossils constrain the observed outline and regions; mollusc-like resemblance, homology and phylogenetic placement remain comparative interpretations, not crown membership or direct ancestry.

Markers show the package's sampled occurrence context, not a complete distribution or a sampling-corrected abundance map; locality and stratum context do not demonstrate ecology or a global absence elsewhere.

title.zh: 齿舌虫伯吉斯页岩样本窗口

description.en: Open the 508–505 Ma Burgess Shale Odontogriphus sample window in the map to inspect the source-linked tooth-row evidence alongside its bounded occurrence context.
description.zh: 在地图中打开 508–505 Ma 的齿舌虫伯吉斯页岩样本窗口，结合其限定出现背景检查带来源关联的齿列证据。

limitations: The 506.5 Ma map age is a rounded midpoint of the 508–505 Ma Burgess Shale sample window, not a direct specimen date, a global species range or a crown-mollusc calibration.

The 189-specimen sample directly records repeated tooth rows and associated soft anatomy from this locality and stratum; radular homology and stem-mollusc placement are comparative morphology and phylogenetic interpretations, not observed feeding or direct ancestry.
Map markers are sampled occurrence context and preserve collection and preservation bias; they do not establish complete distribution, abundance, global FAD/LAD or ecology.

title.zh: 内克托卡里斯伯吉斯页岩软体证据检验

description.en: Open the 508–505 Ma Burgess Shale Nectocaris window in the map to inspect the source-linked soft-body evidence and the limits of its cephalopod interpretation.
description.zh: 在地图中打开 508–505 Ma 的内克托卡里斯伯吉斯页岩窗口，检查带来源关联的软体证据及其头足类解释的界限。

limitations: The 506.5 Ma map age is a rounded midpoint of the 508–505 Ma Burgess Shale context, not a direct specimen date, a global Nectocaris duration or a cephalopod crown age.

Ninety prepared specimens directly constrain soft anatomy at this locality and stratum, but the cephalopod placement is a contested comparative/topological interpretation because diagnostic shell, siphuncle, beak and radula evidence are absent; it does not establish ecology or direct ancestry.

Markers show sampled occurrence context subject to preservation and collection bias, not a complete distribution, global FAD/LAD, abundance estimate or proof that mapped geography is a fossil-to-reconstruction co-registration.

description.en: Open the 520–518 Ma Chengjiang Kutorgina window in the map to inspect the source-linked exceptional-preservation occurrence and its formation-scale limits.
description.zh: 在地图中打开 520–518 Ma 的澄江顾脱贝窗口，检查带来源关联的特殊保存出现记录及其地层尺度边界。

limitations: The 519 Ma map age is the rounded midpoint of a 520–518 Ma formation-scale Chengjiang window, not a direct date for a valve, a global brachiopod FAD/LAD or a continuous lineage range.

Exceptionally preserved calcareous valves with lophophore, gut and pedicle constrain the cited Chengjiang material; morphology and organismal interpretation do not by themselves resolve broader phylogeny, ecology or direct ancestry.

Markers show a locality- and stratum-bounded sampled occurrence context with preservation and collection bias, not complete global distribution, abundance or direct fossil-to-paleomap co-registration.
